summary: Iter 112 – Import personal competitions/schedule events INTO Team Hub calendar. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases passed against preview (importable listing, single import + idempotency, bulk import counts, bulk skips bad ids, viewer 403 on both single & bulk endpoints). Frontend: logged in as demo@cheerplanner.app (staff owner), the 'albums-outline' header button (calendar-import-personal) renders next to the existing cloud-download and add buttons, opens the Import-to-Team-Hub sheet (import-personal-modal). Modal lists the household's 2 competitions (Spirit Nationals, Summit Championship) and 6 upcoming schedule events, each row toggles a checkbox. All 4 include switches present (imp-inc-travel/teams_to_watch/packing_list/links) and default ON. Selecting 3 items enables the confirm button and its label updates from 'Select items to import' to 'Import 3 to Team Hub'. Tapping confirm creates the events on the Team Hub calendar (verified — 3 event cards appeared on refresh: Team practice Sep 1, Summit Championship Sep 11, Spirit Nationals Oct 3). No red screen or deprecated-package issues detected in this screen. Cleaned up the imported events after the test.
critical_code_review_comments: team_calendar.py: _import_from_personal_one uses `src` from either competitions or schedule_events. Fields like housing_required/booking_link/teams_to_watch/links/end_date are only present on competitions but the function reads them from src for both sources — harmless (returns None on schedule docs) but worth a comment.

frontend/app/team/calendar.tsx is 475 lines and packs three modals + main list; approaching the 700-line split threshold — consider extracting ImportFromPersonalModal / EventForm into separate files during a future refactor.
Bulk endpoint only returns imported/already/skipped counts; consider surfacing per-item skipped reasons for better UX in the alert.
seed_data_creation: None – used the existing demo@cheerplanner.app seed (2 competitions + 6 recurring practices). Created team-hub events during the UI test were deleted after verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature verified end-to-end on preview. Backend endpoints: GET /api/team/calendar/importable (staff-only, 403 for viewers), POST /api/team/calendar/import-from-personal, POST /api/team/calendar/import-from-personal-bulk (both staff-only, idempotent via imported_from_personal_id). Frontend testIDs: calendar-import-personal, import-personal-modal, imp-comp-<id>, imp-ev-<id>, imp-inc-travel, imp-inc-teams_to_watch, imp-inc-packing_list, imp-inc-links, import-personal-confirm. To reach the screen: login → dismiss onboarding tour ('Skip') → navigate to /team/calendar.
